example_sentences_in_bangla: এই রাজনৈতিক দলের অভ্যন্তরীণ কলহ একটা কসাইখানা তৈরি করে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The internal conflicts in this political party have turned it into a slaughterhouse.
The battlefield was a real slaughterhouse.
note: The idiom draws from the everyday imagery of a butcher's shop in Bengali society to evoke brutality.
